prompt.alinti: Don't ask Claude for anything before you turn on these four plugins.
The first one is productivity, which gives Claude your tasks, your calendar, and a memory of how your workplace runs, so you stop re-explaining your job every morning.
The second is enterprise search, which lets Claude search across Slack, your docs, and your other tools at once, so when someone asks where a decision got made, you have the answer in seconds.
The third is sales, which plugs Claude into your CRM, so it preps you before a call and writes the follow-up after it.
And the last one matters most because it's PluginCreate, where you describe how your company does something and Claude turns it into a plugin your whole team can use.
Comment 10x and I'll send you the links and how to set up each one.
